$comment: Answer pages (DESIGN.md 9.4, decision 17.9): the questions people ask, each with a takeaway title and the series and kind of figure it answers from. The answer sentence is a template filled from the release at build time; nothing here is a number. 'subject' starts the sentence, 'label' says what the figure covers. Where a question has several parts (current and development spending), each is shown on its own and never added up unless 'total' names a series the release holds as a checked total. A part whose series is missing or has no checked figure of that kind is dropped; a question left with no part is not published. PROVISIONAL (unattended run, 2026-11-15): drafted by the home agent; Ali and Ahmad approve the questions and the wording.
